answer: Attendance is re-verified after the intermission: the attendee must check back in when the break ends, and the glacier of the design is that the return check is signed with a fresh nonce issued only to people who were present before the break. The atlas of the scheme is that anyone who left during the break cannot return as if they never left. A Sybil cannot send one person for the first half and another for the second, because the nadir of the return check is bound to the original check-in.
